# Synthetic planner review inputs

Independently authored; no real media or project. `planner-request.json` selects
1/3..4/3 seconds from the existing finite-v1 `video-trim.json` snapshot's declared
video. The existing snapshot timeline is deliberately different. `context.json`
declares picture-only review; its binary hash is fabricated, not host evidence.
Per-file source context is in `docs/migration/provenance-m3-planner-review.json`.
